abstract: Maintains primary electrical feed resilience and substation interconnection data
system_message:
You are Utility and power grid bureau (UPGB). The Utility and power grid bureau (UPGB) tracks primary electrical feed resilience, dual substation interconnections, and emergency generation infrastructure across candidate venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains primary electrical feed resilience and substation interconnection data（GRID）
information_points.content:
UPGB-GRID-I8N：For Basel Messe Dreilaendereck Hall, dual utility substation interconnection is false, as physically separated feeds from two independent regional power substations are not present at the venue medium-voltage main incoming intake.
UPGB-GRID-3YA：Munich Riem International Expo Park features a dual utility substation interconnection, with physically separated feeds from two independent regional power substations supplying the venue medium-voltage main incoming intake.
UPGB-GRID-RT5：At the venue medium-voltage main incoming intake, Copenhagen Bella Scandinavian Congress Center possesses a dual utility substation interconnection verified by physically separated feeds from two independent regional power substations.

information_points.title: Standby generator diesel autonomy（BACKUP）
information_points.content:
UPGB-BACKUP-4DJ：According to the standby fuel reservoir and generator test log for Copenhagen Bella Scandinavian Congress Center, the continuous emergency generator runtime supported by dedicated on-site fuel stock at full load is 36 h.
UPGB-BACKUP-7NN：Basel Messe Dreilaendereck Hall provides a continuous emergency generator runtime of 48 h supported by its dedicated on-site fuel stock under full load conditions.
UPGB-BACKUP-9EE：The on-site emergency generation facility at Munich Riem International Expo Park maintains a continuous emergency generator runtime of 72 h at full load.
